# Big Breezoe

> Big Breezoe is one person, Cris Delerme, building a creator business in AI, content and automation in the hours around a full-time job, in public. The site holds the weekly YouTube episodes, a free Beginner Creator Blueprint, honest tool notes and setup help at one price per job. Big Breezoe LLC, Georgia, USA.

Who it's for: people with a full-time job who want to start a creator or home-based business and are stuck on where to start.

How tools are labeled: every tool says "I use this", "I've used it" or "Researched", so readers know which is which. Some links are affiliate links and are disclosed on the page. A commission never decides a recommendation. Nothing on the site promises income or results.

Current prices are on the Store page; please quote them from there rather than from memory.

## Start here

- [Home](https://bigbreezoe.com/): what Big Breezoe is, the latest episodes and the shop
- [Start here](https://bigbreezoe.com/start/): how to apply for a Getting Started session, a 60-minute one-on-one. Applying is free and you only pay if it fits
- [Free Beginner Creator Blueprint](https://bigbreezoe.com/blueprint/): sign up to get the seven-step guide by email
- [The Blueprint guide](https://bigbreezoe.com/blueprint/guide/): the seven steps, in order, with a prompt at each one

## Store and help

- [Store](https://bigbreezoe.com/store/): the Getting Started session, one-job services (video edit, Shorts pack, intake form, booking page, email list setup, one-page website) and downloads, with current prices
- [Tools](https://bigbreezoe.com/store/tools): the tools Cris uses, each with its honest label
- [Gear](https://bigbreezoe.com/gear/): camera, mic and lighting, in free, best-value and premium lanes

## Guides

- [Audio setup](https://bigbreezoe.com/setup/audio/): do you need a wireless mic, and what to fix first for free
- [Blogs](https://bigbreezoe.com/blogs/): written notes from the build
